blocks.text: foodpanda Philippines concluded its nationwide CRAVE Partner Summit and Awards 2026 in Manila, gathering merchants and industry leaders to discuss digital innovation, evolving consumer behavior, and strategic partnerships. Ahead of World Food Day, the event underscored the role of local food businesses in driving livelihoods and community growth. Following the Visayas and Mindanao stops in Cebu and Davao, the culminating event in Manila addressed key MSME challenges, including rising costs and digital adoption.
